name: Uptonica – AI assistant and marketing for WooCommerce
author: uptonica

sections.description:
Uptonica is an AI platform for online stores: an AI shopping assistant that answers your customers from your real catalog, email and WhatsApp automations, product content and advertising reports.

This plugin connects your WooCommerce store to your Uptonica workspace without copying API keys by hand.

What the plugin does

  • One-click connection. Click «Connect to Uptonica», choose your workspace, approve access on the standard WooCommerce screen. Your catalog, orders and customers stay in sync.
  • The assistant with a switch. Add the Uptonica code to every page of the shop without editing your theme or Tag Manager. What it shows (the assistant, visit measurement) is chosen in Uptonica.
  • Store updates that keep arriving. WooCommerce switches a webhook off after a few failed deliveries and drops the failed ones. For Uptonica’s webhooks, the plugin sends failed deliveries again later and switches them back on, so your store never silently stops updating.
  • Purchases from the server. A purchase is counted even when the shopper pays on an external page and never returns to the thank-you page, or blocks scripts. It is sent only when the shopper accepted measurement in your cookie banner.

Requirements

  • WooCommerce 8.0 or later.
  • An Uptonica account. You can create one during the connection.
  • A site served over https (WooCommerce’s approval screen requires it).

External services

This plugin connects to Uptonica (https://uptonica.com/), a service run by the plugin’s author. Without it the plugin does nothing.

  • When you click «Connect to Uptonica», your browser is sent to app.uptonica.com with your site address and the address of the plugin page. After you approve on the WooCommerce screen, WooCommerce sends Uptonica a REST API key for your store, and the plugin calls https://app.uptonica.com/api/wordpress/v1/exchange once, from your server, to learn which workspace it joined.
  • When «Add the Uptonica code to every page» is on, every page of the shop loads https://app.uptonica.com/widget/uptonica.js. It shows the AI assistant and, following your cookie banner, measures visits. Visitors’ browsers then talk to app.uptonica.com.
  • When «Send purchases from the server» is on, each paid order whose shopper accepted measurement is sent from your server to https://app.uptonica.com/api/events: order number, total, currency, products, the shopper’s email (used to match the purchase to an existing contact and not stored on the event), IP address and browser user agent, and the analytics cookies already on the shopper’s device (_uton_aid, _ga, _fbp, _fbc).
  • Store updates are sent by WooCommerce’s own webhooks, which Uptonica registers on your store during the connection.

Uptonica terms of service and privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install and activate this plugin.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Uptonica and click «Connect to Uptonica».
sections.faq:
Does the plugin store my API keys?

No. WooCommerce creates the key on its approval screen and sends it to Uptonica directly. The plugin only stores the workspace name and the public code of your Uptonica site tag.

How do I disconnect?

WooCommerce → Uptonica → Disconnect. It deletes the API key and the webhooks Uptonica was given on your store and removes the Uptonica code from your pages.

Which cookie banners are supported for purchases sent from the server?

Any banner that implements the WP Consent API, plus Complianz, CookieYes, Cookiebot, OneTrust and iubenda. With any other banner, a purchase is sent only if the Uptonica code had already been allowed to measure that visitor.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Webhook retries: one waits per product or order however many deliveries failed, Uptonica’s Retry-After is honoured, and retries are spread out so a bulk import does not come back all at once.

1.0.0

  • First release: one-click connection, site tag switch, webhook retries, purchases sent from the server.
